retirementReadiness.reason: The authenticated post-7E.3.4 run proved media resolution and intrinsic bounds but exposed a curated sibling-taxonomy gap, wrapped evidence semantics, and avoidable provider calls during required research. 7E.3.5 compiles shared-entry-to-branch journeys, preserves uninterrupted horizontal rails, and grounds required evidence deterministically. V1 remains dormant until this behavior is exercised against authenticated tenant data.
requiredProof: both named apps resolve to preferred or adequate tenant journeys or complete branch paths
canonical evidence reflects coherent taxonomy coverage rather than an arbitrary stage or flattened branch collection
the main Flow explorer and Canvas V2 resolve the same working absolute screenshot URLs
every canonical screenshot is whole and visible with no hidden right-edge boundary
a primary provider overload hands the same logical turn to fallback or pauses resumably if both providers are unavailable
the completed artboard contains evidence-grounded analytical development at an inspectable scale without identity-validation failure
curated sibling taxonomies resolve a shared entry followed by one complete branch rather than a branch alone or every alternative
each canonical journey remains one uninterrupted horizontal rail while the artboard grows to its intrinsic width
required named-app retrieval commits visibly without consuming a creative provider call
wide canonical rails provide bounded overview and legible segmented model observations
refresh clears the artboard, chat, active work, and undo history back to the canonical starter
